commentary.name: Alexander Maclaren's Expositions of Holy Scripture
commentary.englishName: Alexander Maclaren's Expositions of Holy Scripture

content.text:
SERVICE A GIFT

Numbers 18:7.

All Christians are priests-to offer sacrifices, alms, especially prayers; to make God known to men.

I. Our priesthood is a gift of God’s love.

We are apt to think of our duties as burdensome. They are an honour and a mark of God’s grace.

1. They are His gift-

\ The power to do. All capacities and possessions from Him.

\ The wish to do. ‘Worketh in you to will.’

\ The right to do, through Christ.

2. They are a blessing.

\ Note the good effects on ourselves-the increase of fellowship with Him, the strengthening of all holy desires.

\ The future benefits. Apply this to prayer and to effort on behalf of our fellow-men.

II. Our priesthood is to be done as a service-under a sense of obligation to a master, with diligence \.

III. Our priesthood is to be done as a gift to God-to be done joyfully, giving ourselves back to Him: ‘Yield yourselves unto God’ -’ your reasonable service.’

Then only do we really possess ourselves, and ‘all things are ours, for we are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.’
